selected.title: The clue had to move
selected.texas_link: Houston research team and Texas-focused Texome Project

movement.actor: Texas Children's Hospital and Baylor College of Medicine
movement.action: Published and announced BRSK1 variant research
movement.object: AI-selected candidate plus functional fruit-fly testing

selected.why_today: The September 28th published experiment is a fresh application in the current reporting window, admitted to the Docket and not covered in recent films.
selected.consequence: Human genetic evidence and separate fruit-fly experiments support a likely explanation for the studied families' previously unexplained disorder.
selected.application_change: AI narrowed a genomic search to a candidate gene that researchers could challenge through separate biological experiments.
selected.counter_image: Patient-derived variants only partly restored fly function, and no human treatment result or routine clinical deployment is reported.
selected.earned_take: The AI output earns attention as a testable candidate; the living comparison supplies separate evidence about its function.

agency.next_step: Researchers can continue studying the gene and variation; the announcement supplies no dated clinical deployment step.
agency.who_can_act: Researchers and Texome Project staff can investigate unresolved genetic conditions.

filmability.viewer_question: What turns an AI-selected gene into evidence?
filmability.opening_action: Illustrated fruit fly makes a short movement; a comparison fly moves more readily, establishing a recognizable functional contrast.
filmability.mechanism: Keep AI candidate selection and biological test separate. Compare fly gene disabled, human reference gene, and patient-derived variants; show qualitative movement only.
filmability.human_consequence: Families with an unexplained neurodevelopmental disorder gain a likely genetic explanation, not a demonstrated cure.
filmability.source_limit: Illustrated locomotion explains a qualitative source-reported contrast. No actual assay, measured distance, observed gait, laboratory protocol, treatment or patient recovery is reconstructed.
three_key_images: An unmistakable enlarged fruit fly, six legs and two wings, with qualitative movement on a simple lab-neutral plane; disclose Illustration
A separated conceptual genome candidate BRSK1 beside the fly experiment, keeping computer suggestion distinct from physical confirmation
Three comparable fly states labelled fly gene off / human reference / patient variants, with qualitative partial restoration; no invented charts or measurement scales

asset_leads.inspection: Actual pixels show overhead consultation: white-coated clinician, laptop, tablet and patient hands. No fruit fly, experiment, named patient or gene workflow.
asset_leads.what_it_proves: Only generic consultation context; not this study’s action.

rights_basis.evidence: Article supplies no reuse licence or identified creator for this image

asset_leads.reason: Cannot explain the study and may imply clinical deployment

action_support.pictured_action: Recognizable illustrative fruit fly changes position modestly; compare limited and more ready movement without numeric values
action_support.scope_fit: Conceptual qualitative motion only; no observational claim or invented assay
action_support.relationship: Recognizable illustrative fruit fly changes position modestly; compare limited and more ready movement without numeric values. Conceptual qualitative comparison of source-reported function, never measured trial movement.

action_support.pictured_action: BRSK1 candidate stays visually separate from the reference/variant biological comparison
action_support.scope_fit: Explanatory relationship from the abstract; no molecular surgery, real AI interface or instantaneous gene delivery
action_support.relationship: BRSK1 candidate stays visually separate from the reference/variant biological comparison. Conceptual qualitative comparison of source-reported function, never measured trial movement.

action_support.pictured_action: Reference and variant fly states remain side by side, with the variant showing only partial qualitative restoration
action_support.scope_fit: Functional comparison, not human improvement, treatment or clinical rollout
action_support.relationship: Reference and variant fly states remain side by side, with the variant showing only partial qualitative restoration. Conceptual qualitative comparison of source-reported function, never measured trial movement.

filmability.angle: Mechanism-led News report with Explanatory animation
filmability.strongest_useful_image: The same recognizable fly in comparable reference and variant states; movement is the testable consequence, not a decorative insect insert.
filmability.next_information: Once the viewer sees different functional outcomes, explain that AI selected the candidate but this separate experiment tested it.
filmability.likely_false_inference: AI cured the child, or a normal human gene was given to a patient. Keep all restoration inside the explicitly illustrated fly experiment and state likely explanation, no treatment result.
filmability.missing_truthful_picture: No patient recovery or routine clinical diagnosis picture can be supported; omit these claims.
filmability.format_reason: The source supplies a qualitative experimental comparison; explanatory illustration can show it without mislabelling stock consultation as evidence.
filmability.rejected_approach: Observed documentary cannot be built honestly from the single available generic consultation image.
